extras: HTTPS protects transport, but this is not end-to-end encrypted. Operators with server or backup access may read uploaded content.
intentEvidence: This is an independent community plugin, not an Obsidian product or the official Obsidian Sync service.
problem: Users need a reliable way to synchronize their local Obsidian vault with a cloud service like NoteCloud while maintaining folder structure and web accessibility.

relations.evidence: Existing users may keep lby7469/obsidianplug; do not install both copies in one vault.

summary: NoteCloud Sync provides bidirectional synchronization of Obsidian notes, folders, and various file types with a NoteCloud account, enabling web access and sharing.
